tasks.label: Auto Build C/C++
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" == ".cpp" ]]; then g++ -g "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out"; else gcc -g "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out" -lm; fi
tasks.detail: Auto detect C/C++ file by extension (Only work on Linux)
